- `rorbwin652-12h-standard.out` — source filename `Fig6_7_ aep0p2EY_du12hourtp1.out`; original Git blob `95826bccdbe1f2410ef372ef6b6c2c161d847b99`; **19,020 bytes**, 301 expected hydrograph rows.
- `rorbwin652-12h-batch.out` — source filename `Fig6_7_batch.out`; original Git blob `08ae1d94ef74d666836c8d3fab842e6421851030`; **8,558 bytes**, 80 original event rows and 8 representative references.

The exact Git blob IDs are verified by the copy operation and by focused tests;
`.gitattributes` disables newline normalization. Original frequency tokens,

native calculations or independent additions to the established CMD register.
